_comment: Canonical LoginAudit document shape. client is the authority - it appends a record for every authentication attempt (success or failure). Used for security monitoring, rate-limiting, and brute-force detection. A field mismatch breaks audit trails and security analytics.

login_audit._description: Single authentication attempt record. Append-only. One row per login attempt (success or failure).

user_id.description: User ID the login attempt was for. Null if the user could not be identified.

login_method.description: Authentication method attempted. See status.json auth.login_method.

error_reason.description: Failure reason code. See status.json auth.error_reason. Null on success.

ip_address.description: Client IP address at time of attempt.

cert_fingerprint.description: mTLS certificate fingerprint, if authenticated via certificate.

created_at.description: When the login attempt occurred (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z suffix).
